description: A prose line whose statement swallowed the next CODE line is judged again once cut back to its own line: `careful, world` is a comma sequence, E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT; the code line survives. Before the fix it was kept as code, compiled clean, and threw a ReferenceError at boot.
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet: a bare run that is not valid code is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT; a comma sequence is not a scrml expression (S441 review #6 sub-bullet). Found by the S441 round-4 fuzz.
